info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Knowledge Asset By Param1-spec
info.description: The Knowledge Asset Management API allows organizations to keep their knowledge assets up-to-date by enabling partial updates to specific resources. By utilizing this endpoint, users can make precise modifications to knowledge assets based on the unique identifier provided as a parameter. Typical consumers include knowledge management systems and financial institutions looking to maintain accurate and relevant information. This API streamlines the process of asset management, ensuring that teams can efficiently manage and update their knowledge base.

patch.description: This endpoint allows users to update details of a specific knowledge asset identified by its ID within the knowledge exchange system. This is crucial for maintaining the most current and relevant information related to the asset.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the knowledge asset identified by RES-100045 in the knowledge exchange. It contains the necessary fields to specify the changes required to be made to the asset.

200.description: The request was successful and the resource has been updated.
